newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Chidambaram concludes budget debate reply.
newsitem.headline: India's Chidambaram concludes budget debate reply.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram on Friday concluded his reply to a debate on the Finance Bill that would implement tax and tariff proposals for 1997/98 (April-March), parliament officials said.

Chidambaram was scheduled to put the bill to a vote in the lower house of parliament, Lok Sabha, after 2 p.m. (0830 GMT), they said. Passage of the bill in clause-by-clause voting was expected to take an hour, officials said.

Debate on the Finance Bill, the cornerstone of the 1997/98 budget package, began on Wednesday. The bill, which Chidambaram introduced on February 28, would cut import duties, as well as corporate and personal income tax rates.
Earlier this week, the Lok Sabha approved the government's spending proposals for 1997/98.
